authorship: Original Spot intake prompts; not ACORD wording or a one-to-one paraphrase of the source registry.

defaults.conditionEvaluation: all conditions must match an answered value on the same subject; unresolved parent answers remain unresolved
defaults.selection: reviewed candidates selected using intake evidence; deterministic requirements remain in code

groups.title: Company and request
groups.relevance: Use for every requested line; reuse confirmed shared intake facts before asking.

groups.title: Operations and financial exposure
groups.relevance: Use company facts to identify relevant business supplements; preserve reporting periods.

groups.title: Operating locations
groups.relevance: Repeat for each operating location relevant to a selected line; do not merge locations.

groups.title: Existing insurance and history
groups.relevance: Reuse policy evidence and shared answers; obtain an explicit history period before date-bounded questions.

groups.title: Policy schedule
groups.relevance: Repeat for each relevant current, previous, or underlying policy.

groups.title: Individual loss or incident
groups.relevance: Repeat for reported events, preserving the applicable line and insured entity.

groups.title: General liability terms
groups.relevance: Use for the requested general liability coverage instance.

groups.title: General liability operations
groups.relevance: Select questions matching the business activities and premises exposures.

groups.title: Property insurance terms
groups.relevance: Use for the requested property coverage instance and its insured locations.

groups.title: Building characteristics
groups.relevance: Repeat for each building to be insured; ask only for structures within requested scope.

groups.title: Contents and interruption
groups.relevance: Select for insured contents, inventory, and interruption exposures at this location.

groups.title: Workers’ compensation scope
groups.relevance: Confirm jurisdiction and employer scope before state-specific classification or elections.

groups.title: Payroll and duties
groups.relevance: Repeat by employer, jurisdiction, location, and distinct work classification; do not infer a rating code from a job title alone.

groups.title: Employment practices and workplace safety
groups.relevance: Select according to workforce arrangements and actual work hazards.

groups.title: Owner and officer elections
groups.relevance: Use only for people whose inclusion or exclusion requires an explicit jurisdiction-specific election.

groups.title: Commercial auto coverage
groups.relevance: Use for commercial vehicle liability and physical-damage scope.

groups.title: Vehicle schedule
groups.relevance: Repeat for every vehicle proposed for coverage, retaining its ownership and garaging location.

groups.title: Driver schedule
groups.relevance: Repeat for drivers relevant to the requested business coverage; identifiers need restricted handling.

groups.title: Fleet management
groups.relevance: Select for businesses operating or supervising vehicles.

groups.title: Professional liability coverage
groups.relevance: Use for the requested professional services coverage and continuity needs.

groups.title: Professional services and controls
groups.relevance: Select according to the actual profession, deliverables, clients, and contracts.

groups.title: Cyber coverage scope
groups.relevance: Use to establish requested protection and retentions.

groups.title: Data and technology exposure
groups.relevance: Select according to stored information, digital services, and operational dependence on technology.

groups.title: Identity and access controls
groups.relevance: Select for the business's users, administrators, remote connections, and hosted services.

groups.title: Security operations
groups.relevance: Select for networks, endpoints, applications, and cloud environments the business operates.

groups.title: Recovery and incident response
groups.relevance: Select for restoration, interruption, and incident-management preparedness.

groups.title: People, vendors, and payment controls
groups.relevance: Select according to staff access, outsourced services, and payment workflows.

groups.title: Umbrella and excess structure
groups.relevance: Use for the requested excess layer and reviewed underlying policy schedule.

groups.title: Excess liability exposure
groups.relevance: Reuse relevant liability, fleet, and employer facts; investigate differences from the underlying scope.

groups.title: Construction and contracting
groups.relevance: Select when the business performs construction, installation, repair, or trade contracting.

groups.title: Manufacturing, importing, and distribution
groups.relevance: Select when the business supplies physical products; do not infer manufacturing responsibility from retail sales alone.

groups.title: Food, lodging, and liquor
groups.relevance: Select for restaurants, bars, lodging, catering, and similar hospitality operations.

groups.title: Technology services and software
groups.relevance: Select when the business develops, hosts, administers, or supports technology for customers.

groups.title: Healthcare and licensed care services
groups.relevance: Select only for healthcare or care-service businesses; resolve profession and jurisdiction before specialized questions.

groups.title: Freight and transportation
groups.relevance: Select for carriage of goods, freight brokerage, or transport logistics.

groups.title: Property ownership and management
groups.relevance: Select for landlords, property managers, and real-estate service businesses.
